decisions.reason: Changing the default document language to English does not alter which style system must be implemented or its required coverage.
The accepted Danish style-name language is already represented by the candidate's message-23 MODIFY; no additional or incomplete change remains.
The document's default language does not necessarily change the required stability of pasting content from legacy NXQ templates.
Default document language does not alter the required containment of pasted tables and columns within page margins.
Default document language does not alter the requirement that manual line breaks work reliably after pasting.
The switch to an English default does not change Tab-driven sublevel creation, list coverage, hierarchy, or alignment behavior.
The default-language decision does not change the supported Word for Windows environment or the reliability and multi-user stability requirements.
Default document language does not alter bullet size, appearance, vertical alignment, or font-size scaling behavior.
